key_points: AMD stock gained ~8% last week, reflecting strong AI-driven demand and tight supply.
Broader market optimism on AI and lower oil prices lifted tech shares, including AMD.
Motley Fool favors Broadcom over AMD in the AI chip race, indicating competitive concerns.
Some retail traders warn the rally may be exhausted despite recent price-target hikes.
Analysts note AMD's server leadership and potential GPU roadmap rumors for 2027.
